Measurable Statement: Main pages should load in under 3 seconds for normal users
Rationale: Ensure fast and responsive user experience
Verification Approach: Manual speed test or browser tool

Measurable Statement: Users must log in with a password and account locks after 5 failed attempts
Rationale: Protect user accounts and prevent brute-force attacks

Measurable Statement: A new user should be able to book or register within 30 seconds without help
Rationale: Ensure intuitive and efficient user flow

Measurable Statement: System should be available 95% of the time during normal hours
App must work with screen readers and have clear text contrast
Rationale: Support inclusive access for all users

Measurable Statement: Code should be easy to update and tested before release
Rationale: Enable smooth updates and reduce bugs
